name: Sync
title: Synchronise with a peer server
description: Brings this server and a peer FHIR server to the same content for every resource either changed since their last sync. Changes are found from each side's history (_history with _since, R4B http.html 3.1.0.12). Each resource is merged field by field: a top-level element changed on one side takes that change; one changed on both takes the later save, by each server's own clock. A delete against an edit: the later wins. The result is written to the peer with If-Match, then here; every version stays in each side's history. Ids are kept. AuditEvent and Subscription are not synced. Asynchronous: 202 with Content-Location to $sync-status.

parameter.name: peer
parameter.documentation: The peer server's base URL (http or https).

parameter.name: token
parameter.documentation: A bearer token for the peer, for an account there that may read and write every resource type; held for the run only.
